'''Asset I-12''' was a member of the [[The Shroud's syndicate|intelligence network]] that served the independent operative known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. I-12 was stationed in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]],<ref name="State" /> but around [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.6}}</ref> I-12 and fellow [[asset I-40]] went missing, leading the Shroud to believe them [[Death/Legends|dead]], and the asset's [[Death/Legends|death]] prompted the Shroud to send [[Asset I-4]] to investigate.<ref name="State" />
